patient.key: Perianal skin tags + guaiac positive + 10lb weight loss + father died of colon cancer

sequence.what: 30M, abdominal pain, loose stools, perianal pain — 1-2 months
sequence.decision: Patient recognized — this is chronic diarrhea + weight loss in a young adult

sequence.what: T 37.5, HR 80, BP 129/69, RR 15, BMI 22 — all normal
Crampy pain, no blood in stool, loperamide use, 10lb loss, no travel/antibiotics. Father died of colon cancer. Smokes 1/3 PPD. Occasional marijuana for pain.
sequence.decision: Chronic diarrhea + weight loss + family history of CRC = need scope

sequence.what: Abdomen benign. BUT: perianal skin tags noted on rectal exam + guaiac positive stool.
sequence.decision: Anal tags are the turning point — Crohn's hallmark. IBD direction confirmed.

sequence.status: Placed diagnostic labs and stool studies

sequence.result: Focal ulcerations + normal mucosa = skip lesions. Cobblestone appearance. Terminal ileum + right colon. Rectal sparing.
sequence.diagnosis: Crohn's disease confirmed. NOT ulcerative colitis — rectal sparing is the differentiator.

sequence.result: WBC 8.5K, Hgb 15.0, Hct 45%, Plt 300K — all normal. Normocytic normochromic.

missed.why: Terminal ileum absorbs iron. Normal Hgb doesn't rule out deficiency — ferritin drops first. Crohn's inflammation at absorption site = micronutrient depletion before anemia.
Absorbed in terminal ileum — same inflamed tissue. B12 deficiency precedes macrocytic anemia.
Basic screening panel in any new diagnosis
Crohn's can involve upper GI tract — full staging recommended
Rule out parasitic cause of chronic diarrhea
Free point, any smoker. Smoking specifically WORSENS Crohn's disease.

mechanismsForImage.title: Transmural Inflammation
mechanismsForImage.concept: All four intestinal layers burning — mucosa, submucosa, muscularis, serosa. Unlike UC which is mucosal-only.

mechanismsForImage.title: Skip Lesions
mechanismsForImage.concept: Patchy inflamed segments alternating with normal mucosa. Terminal ileum + right colon. Rectal sparing.

mechanismsForImage.title: Non-caseating Granuloma
mechanismsForImage.concept: Macrophage aggregate deep in submucosa — the histological hallmark of Crohn's.

mechanismsForImage.title: Cobblestone Appearance
mechanismsForImage.concept: Linear serpentine ulcers intersecting raised polypoid mucosal islands.

mechanismsForImage.title: Fistula Formation
mechanismsForImage.concept: Transmural inflammation bores through all layers — a fistula channel connecting lumen to adjacent structures.

mechanismsForImage.title: Perianal Skin Tags
mechanismsForImage.concept: The sentinel finding on exam — extraintestinal Crohn's manifesting at the anal verge.

mechanismsForImage.title: Iron + B12 Malabsorption
mechanismsForImage.concept: Terminal ileum inflamed — rust-colored iron particles and cobalt-blue B12 cannot absorb through burned transport channels.

mechanismsForImage.title: Crohn's vs UC Contrast
mechanismsForImage.concept: Left: UC — continuous superficial mucosal inflammation, rectum involved. Right: Crohn's — transmural deep fire, skip pattern, rectal sparing.

mechanismsForImage.title: Mesalamine Mechanism
mechanismsForImage.concept: Steroid molecule descends as cooling rain onto inflamed mucosa, extinguishing the cytokine inferno.
